name: Elite: keyboard
summary: The text tables, the key bytes, the keyboard scan, the joysticks, the steering accumulators and the IM2 interrupt.

entries.name: ScanJoystick
entries.summary: ScanKeyboard's row loop end; after the last row the joystick's four bits replace KeySteer's, reversed as the options say

entries.name: KeyPressed
entries.summary: Key E (bit 5 - E) of row D (8 the CAPS SHIFT row): its character into KeyCode, its bit into its key byte

entries.name: ScanKeyboard
entries.summary: The eight half-rows from $FEFE to $7FFE: every key down through KeyPressed; KeyDigits 0 and KeyCode $FF first

entries.name: ReadControls
entries.summary: In a space view: the steering bits into the accumulators RollControl (N, M), PitchControl (X, S), SpeedControl (SPACE, SYMBOL SHIFT); KeySteer cleared

entries.name: IM2Entry
entries.summary: The address the vector gives: JR IM2Handler

entries.name: IM2Handler
entries.summary: The interrupt: its own stack below $FFBF, the registers saved, ScanKeyboard, ReadControls and the sound (SoundTickVector)

entries.name: IM2On
entries.summary: I = $FD, IM 2 (known from the code only: it ran before the recordings started)

entries.name: IM1On
entries.summary: IM 1 (for the tape routines in the ROM; known from the code only)

labels.name: TextSpare
labels.comment: Three bytes no code reads (known from the code only)

labels.name: TokenTable
labels.comment: The standard tokens' address ($F11E): PrintCode skips n zero-ended strings from it

labels.name: OtherTable
labels.comment: The other tokens' address ($F4F5): PrintOther skips n - 1

labels.name: StdTokens
labels.comment: The standard set's 149 strings (tools/tokens.py --set std), each ended by a zero

labels.name: OtherTokens
labels.comment: The other set's 263 strings (tools/tokens.py --set other): the missions, the planet descriptions, the commander menu

labels.name: TokensSpare
labels.comment: Eight zero bytes after the tables (known from the code only)

labels.name: KeyScreens
labels.comment: Keys down: ENTER 1, L 2, K 4, P 8, O $10, I $20, 0 $40 (the joystick's fire), Y $80 (the cloak)

labels.name: KeySteer
labels.comment: N 1 (roll left), M 2 (roll right), X 4 (climb), S 8 (dive), SPACE $10 (faster), SYMBOL SHIFT $20 (slower): the joystick's bits 0-3

labels.name: KeyViews
labels.comment: 1-4 bits 0-3 (the views, docked the launch and the trading screens), H $10 (hyperspace), G $20 (galactic), J $40 (the jump drive), CAPS SHIFT $80 (pause)

labels.name: KeyCombat
labels.comment: A 1 (fire), T 2 (target a missile), F 4 (fire the missile), U 8 (unarm), E $10 (E.C.M.), W $20 (energy bomb), Q $40 (escape pod), C $80 (docking computer)

labels.name: KeyChart
labels.comment: B $10 (the cursor home), D $20 (the distance), R $40 (a planet's name)

labels.name: KeyCode
labels.comment: The last key's character (KeyCodes); $FF none, $FE DELETE (CAPS SHIFT with 0)

labels.name: Options
labels.comment: The pause menu's options: bits 0-1 the controls (0 keyboard, 1 Kempston, 2 Cursor, 3 Sinclair), 2 recentring (R), 3 damping (D), 4 both axes reversed, 5 the vertical axis reversed, 6 the misjump (F), 7 sound

labels.name: KeyDigits
labels.comment: 9 1, 5 2, 8 4, 6 8, 7 $10: the Cursor and Sinclair joysticks' keys

labels.name: VectorFiller
labels.comment: $FE bytes: what is left of a 257-byte IM2 table $FD00-$FE00 (the bytes past $FD00 still give $FEFE for a low bus byte)

labels.name: KeyCodes
labels.comment: Each key's character by the index: SPACE, ENTER, P, 0, 1, Q, A, CAPS SHIFT (0), then the next bit of each row

labels.name: LaserItems
labels.comment: The equipment item of each laser kind 1-4 (5 pulse, 6 beam, 13 military, 14 mining): read at $FD89 + kind

labels.name: StatusBands
labels.comment: The status page's colour bands (ColourBands: cells x 8 + rows, a row 0 ends)

labels.name: InventoryBands
labels.comment: The inventory's

labels.name: OtherPairs
labels.comment: The other set's 13 two-letter pairs (codes $D7 on); ControlRandomName uses those from $FD9B

labels.name: StdPairs
labels.comment: The standard set's 32 pairs (codes $80-$9F), also the system names' syllables: AL LE XE GE ZA CE BI SO US ES AR MA IN DI RE A? ER AT EN BE RA LA VE TI ED OR QU AN TE IS RI ON, as BBC Elite's

labels.name: DataBands
labels.comment: The data screen's colour bands

labels.name: MarketBands2
labels.comment: The market prices' colour bands

labels.name: VectorByte
labels.comment: $FE (the filler's last byte)

labels.name: IM2Vector
labels.comment: $FEFE: the IM2 vector for the bus byte $FF (I = $FD), the handler's JR at $FEFE

labels.name: RollControl
labels.comment: The roll accumulator (sign and magnitude): its high byte $FF09 is the roll rate CopyRates takes

labels.name: PitchControl
labels.comment: The pitch accumulator, the rate in $FF0B

labels.name: SpeedControl
labels.comment: The speed accumulator, the speed in $FF0D

labels.name: IM2SavedSP
labels.comment: The interrupted program's SP

labels.name: KeyTable
labels.comment: Each key's (offset from $FC08, mask) by the index; Z and V have the mask 0
